title: Directions
note: Verbatim, typos included ("right me", "clcokwise", "North-Eeast", "coverd"). Never edited: corrections live in src/items/oir/. Letters cut off at the photo's right edge on page 30 (Q29-34) and page 32 (Q65-66) are completed from context; the keys flag where a cut digit matters. Statement lists (Q57-59) are split onto their own lines. The chapter prints no direction (text null). A book name that matches a real candidate's name is replaced with a neutral one (D21, D27); such questions carry "renamed": true and the original is not recorded.

questions.stem: A cyclist rides 2 km towards East. Walked and then turned left and covered 1 km. walked. From there, he took a left turn and walked 800 meters to reach a tea shop. After stopping there for some time, he turned towards south and walked 500 metres. From there, he took a right turn and walked 1.2 km. walked. Finally he took a right turn and walked 1 km. walked. In which direction is he now from his starting position ?
Ashish walks 20 kms towards North. He takes a right turn and walks 20 kms. and he takes a right turn and walks 20 kms. In which direction is he from his starting point ?
Suman walks 15 kms towards North. She takes a right turn and walks 15 kms. She takes a right turn and walks 15 kms. In which direction is he from his starting point?

In the morning after sunrise a boy rode his bicycle 4 km towards west. Then he took a right turn and cycled for 6 km and again took a right turn and cycled for 6 km to reach his school. In which direction is the school from the starting point?

Walked and finally after taking a right turn and then walked 1 km. After walking he reached point 'K'. In which direction was he walking when he reached there?

From here, he takes a right turn and travels 4 km, and again takes a right turn and travels 4 km. From here, he took a straight turn to reach point X. If John is now moving in the North-West direction, in which direction did he start from the hotel?

After covering a distance of 4 km he finally takes a left turn and travels straight. In which direction was Hrithik heading in the end?

Ram walks 4 km towards north from his university campus and then he takes a left turn to reach his department. After walking 2.5 km to his department, he takes a left turn and walks 4 km to reach the conference room. In which direction is he now from his starting point?

When the bus reached the school, it was facing south-east, then which direction was the bus facing when it dropped Anand home?
